body:
_Migrated from issue #870, filed 2026-07-13._

Smart (magic) shelves can't be marked for Kobo sync in the new UI, while ordinary shelves can (the "Enable Kobo sync" button in the shelf view). Part of the shelf-parity umbrella #867.

The backend is already wired for this end to end — only the new UI is missing the control:

- `MagicShelf.kobo_sync` column exists (`cps/ub.py:486`, with its migration at `ub.py:1807`).
- The create and edit endpoints already accept and persist it (`cps/web.py:1516`/`1540` and `web.py:1646`/`1669`).
- The Kobo sync protocol already materialises kobo_sync magic shelves into a device's sync set (`cps/kobo.py:138-190`, `get_magic_shelf_book_ids_for_kobo`), gated by the global admin setting `config_kobo_sync_magic_shelves`.

The gap is SPA-only: `frontend/src/pages/MagicShelfView.tsx` renders no Kobo toggle and `frontend/src/pages/MagicShelf.tsx` never sends `kobo_sync` in its create/edit payload. Fix: add a toggle mirroring `Shelf.tsx`'s `toggleKoboSync` (`frontend/src/pages/Shelf.tsx:138`), gated on the per-user Kobo feature (`me.features.kobo_sync`) plus the global magic-shelf setting (surface `config_kobo_sync_magic_shelves` in the SPA feature payload so the toggle only shows when it can do something).

Credit: @auspex (#867).

resolution.note: Shipped 2026-07-20 in f74c280fe (#870); the SPA smart-shelf view now renders an 'Enable Kobo sync' toggle (MagicShelfView.tsx:127). The finding was migrated from #870 on 2026-08-05 as open, but the fix had already landed 16 days earlier — stale on arrival, not a regression. Confirmed reachable from origin/main.

title: New UI: Kobo-sync toggle for smart shelves (backend already wired)
